title: The Reeds and the boss pull themselves out of the sinkhole by their arms, and the first opening waits for its quake to be able to sound
context: Owner, 2026-10-10: "1) we need a tremor/sinkhole animation sound with the first opening. 2) both the smaller Reeds and the larger boss emerge as if from an elevator, it looks unnatural. let's have them emerge by stretching their limbs, as if they were pulling themselves out from the depth." Follows 2026-10-10-boss-bait-sinkhole-twenty-reeds-bait-default, where every creature's drawing was lifted out of the hole over 1.5 s while its body stood still on its floor, and the lab already played the game's sinkhole_quake on each opening (td-tab.js's call, at the camera's distance in game units). The kit (src/fx/nih-dairia/*), src/sentry-pilot.js, the game's src/fx/*, src/game-breaches.js and src/sinkhole.js are untouched.
outcome: THE QUAKE. The call was there; the sound was not: src/audio.js creates its context and decodes the samples only on the player's first gesture, and a bait round opens its ground on its own about three seconds after the page loads, so the first quake was refused for a context that did not run (the second, the boss's, came after the player had clicked). Now the page's FIRST opening holds its trigger until the quake can sound (src/labs/boss/sinkhole.js: audio.whenRunning, then prime('sinkhole_quake'); while it holds the adapter is stepped with no time, so it neither triggers nor runs its opening, and the Reeds wait below), at most wave.sinkhole.hold = 8 s; then it opens with the game's own quake, at the game's distance and gain (the spec's 0.8 by the falloff: 0.50 from the seat). Later openings never wait. The lab logs every quake (for whom, distance, gain, context, a live voice). PULLING OUT (src/domain/boss-emerge.js the rule, src/labs/boss/pull-out.js the drive, for the Reeds in src/labs/boss/wave.js and the boss in boss-tab.js): after lead 0.35 s in the hole (drawn 1.15 times its height down), the arms reach up first, then out over the hole's lip in an arc, one after another (stagger 0.35 of the reach), each to its own grip on the lip along its own direction (1.05 times the rim's distance, at least just past its rest radius, at most 1.7 times it: a Reed 4 m off a 10 m hole grips at 7.3, 9.5, 12.3 and 9.6 m against a 7 m rest); then the body hauls itself up (the drawing lifted in 2 surges for a Reed, 3 for the boss, never going back) while the grips come down with it in the body's frame, so the tips stay planted on the lip; then the arms let go and it walks. Reeds: reach 0.8 s, haul 2 s, release 0.4 s; the boss: 1.2, 3.5, 0.5 s. HOW: the body still stands on its own floor with its motion off, the solver never seeing the ground move (lowering the floor or the nodes would have the contact solve throw the body); the arms are pulled by the lab. The kit's muscles alone could not do it: the gait's feet can be set to the grips (the kit's own controller then leads each arm there), but behavior.js removes its own net vertical force, so it squashed the torso instead of lifting the arms (tried in node: the tips stayed on the floor). The grab constraint is one point for the whole body. So the lab's drive rides the kit's fixed step: while a creature emerges its behaviour's step is an instance property that calls the class's own method and then adds one acceleration per arm (kp 3000 toward its goal, kd 110 against its tips' mean velocity, capped at 2500 native m/s^2) on the arm's outer nodes by their weight, times the grip's hold; up, the property is deleted. No kit file changed.
alternatives: Playing the first quake late, on the first gesture, if the opening is still under way (rejected: it would start partway through the 7 s animation; the owner asked for the sound with the opening, so the opening waits for the sound instead, capped so a viewer who never clicks still sees it)
Holding every opening for the sound (rejected: once the context runs, every later quake sounds; only the page's first can be early)

Lowering the creature's floor plane (phys.floor, the creature's own copy) and raising it under the body (rejected: one plane under the whole body lifts the torso with the arms, the elevator again, and a moving floor is a contact impulse every step)
The kit's grab constraint on the arm tips (rejected: one target for one weighted point, so it can lift all the tips together but not spread them to separate grips, and its compliance is fixed at 90)
The gait's feet alone (rejected: the kit's controller removes its own net vertical force; in node the torso squashed 0.4 of its height and the tips never rose)

Driving the emergence on the wave's slowed clock (rejected: at twenty Reeds the wave's clock runs at x0.2-0.3, which would make each emergence 10-15 s of real time; the plan follows the lab's clock as the turns did, and the drive's tracking lag is a few millimetres)
evidence: node --check on every edited file; npm test 231 programs green (test/boss-emerge.mjs new: the phases in order with the hold in and out, the haul never going back in its surges, an arm up before out and the arms one after another, the rim along each arm, the grips' bounds; and the kit's own Reed (240 and 120 Hz) and boss in node out of a hole as the lab lays it out: tips over the surface at 0.54 s and the torso at 1.90 s after the turn for a Reed (0.55 / 1.96 s at 120 Hz), 0.62 / 3.22 s for the boss, the tips on the lip through the haul, no drift, fastest node 1.27 native m/s, the kit's own step again after; test/boss-sinkhole.mjs: the hole's width in metres, the first opening held 2.0 s until its quake could sound and played then with its gain and a live voice, a later opening not held, the cap at 1 s with no gesture); npm run check, npm run build green

from a snapshot of commit c3e7c92e (refactor-run, not pushed), sequentially, one headless Chrome (memory WARN on pinned swap, 29 % headroom): --boss-emerge new and green: before any gesture the first opening held 2.7 s, nothing opened, no quake, no Reed out; a trusted T key started the context: the ground opened then and the spy on the lab's audio saw sinkhole_quake on that opening (rumbling, age 0.016 s, distance 0.544 game units), the lab's log a live voice, context running, gain 0.50; the boss's opening sounded its own (four quakes over two rounds). Each emergence on the lab clock: below > tremor > reach > haul > release > up; first seen with tips and torso under the surface (Reed -4.4 / -3.8 m, boss -8.1 / -9.8 m); tips over it 0.07-0.28 s into the reach, torso over it 1.47-1.53 s (Reed) and 2.75-2.82 s (boss) after the reach began, both up within the 3.2 / 5.2 s budget; fastest node 38-64 m/s (the kit's body scaled in space, not time); solver 5.3 ms mean for two Reeds (15 max), 3.7-4.0 ms for the boss; no frame error; the second Reed still below as the first started

then --boss-friends, --boss and --boss-carcass green; --boss-wave green with twenty Reeds (every one below > tremor > reach > haul > release > up, each 4.0 m off the centre, the first out at the sinkhole's age 7.12 s, the boss's lift climbing from 17.3 m down, 120 Hz at twenty, 50 Reeds all up)

frames every 0.25 s of lab clock through each emergence, looked at (scratchpad emerge-reed-seat-NN.png, emerge-boss-seat-NN.png, emerge-reed-close-NN.png, emerge-boss-close-NN.png and a contact sheet of each): from the free orbit close, the Reeds' arms come over the far lip one after another and lie gripping the crater's edge before the torso shows, the torso rises between them over the haul, then they let go and walk; the boss's six arms the same, the body coming up between them; from the seat's thermal the hot arms spread over the crater first and the body's heat grows between them; no snapping or jump between frames
